text:
leo_cs: hi team — kickoff for Cedarfall private deployment. Quick list: network ranges, IAM roles, KMS CMK policy, and audit log shipping. Wanted to sync before tomorrow's cutover smoke run.

nina_cloud: morning — Cedarfall VPC is 172.20.0.0/16. Please avoid 172.20.128.0/18 which is reserved for partner overlay. We plan three subnets: app/public (172.20.1.0/24), app/private (172.20.2.0/24), mgmt (172.20.64.0/26).

sam_netops: firewall rules needed: allow outbound TCP 443 to redwood egress IP range 18.194.0.0/15 and allow inbound from redwood bastion for admin ports during test window. We'll need the bastion IP or a CIDR pool.

leo_cs: we'll ask Redwood to provide a CIDR pool. Tara, is the smoke test still 10:00 AM PT?

tara_pm: yes 10:00 AM PT. We only have a 2hr window. Please treat the KMS key as a blocker if not validated by 09:00.

kevin_sec: KMS checklist from security: 1) CMK alias alias/redwood/cedarfall; 2) enable automatic rotation; 3) key policy must allow the Redwood service role to Encrypt/Decrypt/GenerateDataKey; 4) CloudTrail must be capturing kms:Encrypt kms:Decrypt events to the audit bucket.

leo_cs: noted. Nina, will you share the CMK policy draft when ready?

nina_cloud: posting draft below. it's minimal and scoped to the redwood role.

```json
{ "Version": "2012-10-17", "Statement": [ { "Sid": "EnableRedwoodUse", "Effect": "Allow", "Principal": { "AWS": "arn:aws:iam::210987654321:role/redwood-service" }, "Action": [ "kms:Encrypt", "kms:Decrypt", "kms:GenerateDataKey" ], "Resource": "*" } ] }
```

kevin_sec: small request — add a condition restricting use to the Cedarfall account (aws:SourceAccount) and optionally allow use only when request originates from the redwood-service role. I'll review after the updated policy.

sam_netops: on audit logs — Cedarfall prefers forwarding to Datadog and a backup S3 bucket. We will need a cross-account role for Redwood to write logs if Redwood-managed observability is used. For now, plan is native forward to our Datadog intake.

leo_cs: high-level CS action items: - collect bastion CIDR from Redwood - get final CMK policy and alias - confirm log forwarding method and role ARNs - verify IAM roles created: redwood-service, redwood-logs-writer.

opsbot: Reminder: onboarding doc updated at https://redwood.internal/onboard/cedarfall. Runbook step 4 (create-roles) marked pending.

nina_cloud: we'll create the IAM roles today and post ARNs here. Also will add the alias and enable rotation once Kevin signs off.

kevin_sec: once policy posted, I'll do a 2-hr turnaround security review. If any issues, I'll call for a short rollback test.

leo_cs: renewal/contract note: renewal risk currently medium due to audit log integration and KMS policy outstanding. If we delay enabling centralized audit or rotation beyond cutover we'll need to record exceptions in the account health dashboard which may affect renewal weighting.

tara_pm: logged — product compliance wants the exception window minimized. prefer <7 days.

sam_netops: one dev note: our load balancer health checks will come from internal IPs in 172.20.1.0/24 during smoke. We'll whitelist that on the Redwood side if needed.

leo_cs: any blockers for tomorrow's smoke run?

nina_cloud: KMS policy pending kevin review, bastion CIDR pending from Redwood, roles will be ready. otherwise no blockers.

kevin_sec: ACK — will review the policy as soon as posted.

leo_cs: plan: Nina to post final policy and role ARNs by EOD, Keystone (Redwood) to provide bastion CIDR by 07:00 PT tomorrow. CS to update renewal risk after validation. We'll collect feedback in the onboarding doc and do a retro post-cutover.

nina_cloud: will post in 2 hours. thanks everyone. :rocket:
